title: Node authority inspector
description: Objective: render the node identity, lifecycle, authority, lease, and approved-plan facts named by the pinned control-room contract without deriving any of them in the client. Deliverable: apps/control-room/src/nodes/node-authority.tsx and node-authority.test.tsx, a presentation-only React inspector over explicit daemon-projected/preclassified props. It must show objective, criteria, write scope, phase, daemon-supplied legal commands, current authority hash, lease principal/epoch/expiry, separate activity and renewal silence, plan/approval hashes, and reopen count with stable cr.inspector test IDs. NOT in scope: query-response schemas, fetching, routing/mounting, command construction, lifecycle inference, attempt/context/evidence rendering, or editing kernel.tsx/main.tsx. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room exec vitest run src/nodes/node-authority.test.tsx.
definitionOfDone: The focused tests prove identity, phase, current authority hash, lease principal/epoch/expiry, both silence datums, plan/approval binding, and reopen count render under the specified cr.inspector section IDs.
Legal commands and every validity/currentness label come only from explicit input props; the component contains no lifecycle transition table or inferred authority state.
Absent or malformed truth metadata renders an explicit UNKNOWN presentation with a keyboard-reachable provenance affordance and never a success/valid label.
node-authority.tsx and node-authority.test.tsx are each <=250 physical lines and the exact focused verification command exits 0.
taskRails: This is a presentation component contract, not a daemon query-response or domain-record schema; do not invent transport fields or fetch logic.
Use the pinned design vocabulary when it conflicts with the older UI draft, and render actions only from supplied nextAllowedCommands.
Own and stage only apps/control-room/src/nodes/node-authority.tsx and node-authority.test.tsx.
